name: pulse
description: Read-only MCP access to the Glowming Pulse /v1/* analytics API (daily snapshot, weekly digest, and the nine BigQuery marts) for the Riven Dashboard 2026. Internal — Riven OSS only.

bearer_token.title: Pulse API bearer token
bearer_token.description: Your Pulse API bearer token. Riven OSS issues this to you — ask Riaan if you do not have one. It is stored by the plugin and never shown to the assistant.

base_url.title: Pulse API base URL
base_url.description: Production Cloud Run service. Leave as default unless pointing at a local dev instance.
